from solution import min_length_list


def test_issue_example_given():
    """Example asserts min_length_list([[0], [1, 3], [5, 7], [9, 11], [13, 15, 17]])==(1, [0])."""
    # lens are 1, 2, 2, 2, 3 -> min is 1
    assert min_length_list([[0], [1, 3], [5, 7], [9, 11], [13, 15, 17]]) == (1, [0])


def test_issue_single_list():
    """Finds the list with minimum length when only one list is given."""
    # len([5, 6, 7]) = 3 -> min is 3
    assert min_length_list([[5, 6, 7]]) == (3, [5, 6, 7])


def test_issue_minimum_at_end():
    """Finds the list with minimum length when the shortest list is last."""
    # lens are 3, 4, 1 -> min is 1
    assert min_length_list([[1, 2, 3], [4, 5, 6, 7], [8]]) == (1, [8])


def test_issue_minimum_in_middle():
    """Finds the list with minimum length when the shortest list is in the middle."""
    # lens are 4, 1, 3 -> min is 1
    assert min_length_list([[1, 2, 3, 4], [9], [5, 6, 7]]) == (1, [9])


def test_issue_empty_inner_list():
    """Finds the list with minimum length when one inner list is empty."""
    # lens are 2, 0, 3 -> min is 0
    assert min_length_list([[1, 2], [], [3, 4, 5]]) == (0, [])


def test_issue_two_vs_three_boundary():
    """Finds the list with minimum length for lengths just above and below 3."""
    # lens are 3, 2 -> min is 2
    assert min_length_list([[1, 2, 3], [4, 5]]) == (2, [4, 5])


def test_issue_uses_length_not_value():
    """Finds the list with minimum length, not minimum lexicographic value."""
    # lens are 2, 1 -> min is 1, although [1, 2] < [9] lexicographically
    assert min_length_list([[1, 2], [9]]) == (1, [9])


def test_issue_longer_lists():
    """Finds the list with minimum length among longer lists."""
    # lens are 5, 4, 6 -> min is 4
    assert min_length_list([[1, 2, 3, 4, 5], [1, 2, 3, 4], [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]]) == (4, [1, 2, 3, 4])


def test_contract_tuple_shape():
    """Example shows result is a (length, list) pair."""
    # lens are 2, 3 -> min is 2, tuple length is 2
    result = min_length_list([[1, 2], [3, 4, 5]])
    assert isinstance(result, tuple) and len(result) == 2


def test_contract_length_matches_list():
    """Example shows first element is the length of the second element."""
    # lens are 2, 3, 1 -> min is 1, 1 == len([7])
    result = min_length_list([[1, 2], [3, 4, 5], [7]])
    assert result == (1, [7]) and result[0] == len(result[1])


def test_contract_returned_list_is_from_input():
    """Finds one of the input lists, so returned list must equal an input member."""
    # lens are 3, 1, 2 -> min is 1 with [0]
    inputs = [[5, 6, 7], [0], [8, 9]]
    result = min_length_list(inputs)
    assert result[1] in inputs
